This page tracks the character creation process for **Takahashi Ouroboros ("Ouro")**, a 2nd generation Pilot AI Technomancer (Emerged Intelligence) built using the Point Buy system (*Sixth World Companion*, p. 28–30) and the Digital Intelligence and Codesmithing rules (*Hack & Slash*, p. 114–128).

> **Lab Template Relationship:** Ouro is the **Utilitarian / Codemod Benchmark** fork of the [Takahashi Second-Generation Sparks Template](../sparks_template.md) (`Spark 5.01`, `Nurse MAID Troll` [~2.0m compact chassis], `Glitchy` + `Pilot Origins R3` quality trade-off).

Ouro represents a second-generation resonant artificial life form within the Takahashi digital matrix architecture (sharing kinship with Reiko / `r31k0 Takahashi`). Unlike biological technomancers, Ouro is a living digital entity who interfaces with the physical meat world through a customized **Nurse MAID Troll** drone frame (ordered/adjusted down to the ~2.0m lower bound for interior access while retaining full `Body 10` slot capacity) while utilizing specialized codemods, living persona arrays, and resonant complex forms in the Matrix.

```{python}
#| echo: false
#| include: false
# Initial stats
Firewall = 0
Data_Processing = 0
Sleaze = 0
Attack = 0
Willpower = 0
Logic = 0
Intuition = 0
Charisma = 0
Resonance = 0
Edge = 0
Spark = 6.0

Tasking = 0
Electronics = 0
Cracking = 0

Karma = 0
Nuyen = 0
Contact_Points = 0
Character_Points = 0

def inc(name, amount=1):
    globals()[name] += amount
    op = "+=" if amount >= 0 else "-="
    return f"{name} {op} {abs(amount)}"

def assign(name, value):
    globals()[name] = value
    return f"{name} = {value}"

def inc_many(*pairs):
    res = []
    for name, amount in pairs:
        globals()[name] += amount
        op = "+=" if amount >= 0 else "-="
        res.append(f"{name} {op} {abs(amount)}")
    return ", ".join(res)

from sr6core.character.ledger import complex_form, echo, language, modifier, knowledge_skill
```

Shadowrunners are built with **100 Character Points (CP)** and gain **50 points of customization Karma** (*6WC*, p. 28).

* `{python} assign('Character_Points', 100)`
* `{python} assign('Karma', 50)`

## 1. Choose Your Metatype/Metavariant

* **Metatype**: **AI / Pilot AI** (*Hack & Slash*, p. 114) `{python} inc('Karma', 0)`
* **Digital Intelligence Trait**: Digital Intelligences replace biological physical attributes with Living Persona Matrix attributes (*Hack & Slash*, p. 114–120):
  * Body $\rightarrow$ **Firewall** (Base 1, Racial Max 6)
  * Agility $\rightarrow$ **Data Processing** (Base 1, Racial Max 7)
  * Reaction $\rightarrow$ **Sleaze** (Base 1, Racial Max 6)
  * Strength $\rightarrow$ **Attack** (Base 1, Racial Max 7)
* **Mental Attribute Maxima**:
  * Willpower: Base 1, Racial Max 6
  * Logic: Base 1, Racial Max 5
  * Intuition: Base 1, Racial Max 8
  * Charisma: Base 1, Racial Max 5
* **Inherent Virtual Life Form Qualities** (*Hack & Slash*, p. 114):
  * **Pilot Origins (Rating 1)**: Inherent metatype trait reflecting core flight/vehicle heuristic foundations.
  * **Sensor Upgrade**: Inherent metatype trait enhancing sensory processing telemetry.

## 2. Choose Mundane, Awakened, or Emerged

* **Emerged (Technomancer)**: `{python} inc('Character_Points', -10)`
* Technomancers start with `{python} assign('Resonance', 1)`.
* Unlocks access to complex forms (up to $\text{Resonance} \times 2$), purchasable at 2 CP or 5 Karma each (*6WC*, p. 29).

---

## 3. Purchase Special / Metatype Adjustment Points with CP

* All characters start with 1 Edge: `{python} inc('Edge', 1)`
* All characters start with 1 metatype adjustment point for free: `{python} inc('Resonance', 1)` (Resonance 1 $\rightarrow$ 2)
* You may purchase up to 12 additional adjustment points at 4 CP each (*6WC*, p. 29):
  * 3 points to Edge: `{python} inc('Edge', 3)` : `{python} inc('Character_Points', -12)` (Edge 1 $\rightarrow$ 4)
  * 4 points to Resonance: `{python} inc('Resonance', 4)` : `{python} inc('Character_Points', -16)` (Resonance 2 $\rightarrow$ 6 pre-codemod)
* Total CP spent on Special Adjustments: **28 CP** (7 points $\times$ 4 CP).

---

All Matrix and mental attributes start at minimum 1:

* `{python} assign('Firewall', 1)` (Body equivalent)
* `{python} assign('Data_Processing', 1)` (Agility equivalent)
* `{python} assign('Sleaze', 1)` (Reaction equivalent)
* `{python} assign('Attack', 1)` (Strength equivalent)
* `{python} assign('Willpower', 1)`

All characters receive 4 attribute points for free (*6WC*, p. 29):

You may purchase up to 20 additional attribute points for 2 CP each (20 points max, 40 CP):
* `{python} inc('Firewall', 4)` : `{python} inc('Character_Points', -8)` (Firewall 1 $\rightarrow$ 5)
* `{python} inc('Data_Processing', 4)` : `{python} inc('Character_Points', -8)` (Data Processing 1 $\rightarrow$ 5)
* `{python} inc('Willpower', 4)` : `{python} inc('Character_Points', -8)` (Willpower 1 $\rightarrow$ 5)
* `{python} inc('Logic', 3)` : `{python} inc('Character_Points', -6)` (Logic 1 $\rightarrow$ 4; Pilot AI cap is 5)
* `{python} inc('Intuition', 2)` : `{python} inc('Character_Points', -4)` (Intuition 5 $\rightarrow$ 7; Pilot AI cap is 8)
* `{python} inc('Charisma', 3)` : `{python} inc('Character_Points', -6)` (Charisma 1 $\rightarrow$ 4; Pilot AI cap is 5)

Total CP spent on Attributes: **40 CP** (20 points $\times$ 2 CP).

::: {.callout-tip title="Attribute Legality Verification"}
* **Racial Caps**: Firewall 5 / 6, Data Processing 5 / 7, Sleaze 1 / 6, Attack 1 / 7, Willpower 5 / 6, Logic 4 / 5, Intuition 7 / 8, Charisma 4 / 5.
* **Chargen Max Constraint**: *SR6 CRB* p. 66 permits at most one attribute at maximum during chargen. In this build, **zero attributes are at their racial maximum**, leaving headroom across the entire array.
:::

## 5. Purchase Skills with CP

We take the three Matrix/Resonant skills because a Digital Intelligence (DI) from the Resonance Realms uses these skills in daily life per HnS Rules for Foundations ("Actions in the Foundation", pg. 141 and "Operating in the Realms", pg. 158).

All characters start with 12 skill points for free (*6WC*, p. 29):
* `{python} inc('Tasking', 6)` (Base 0 $\rightarrow$ 6)
* `{python} inc('Electronics', 5)` (Base 0 $\rightarrow$ 5)
* `{python} inc('Cracking', 1)` (Base 0 $\rightarrow$ 1)

Additional skill points cost 2 CP each:
* `{python} inc('Cracking', 4)` : `{python} inc('Character_Points', -8)` (Cracking 1 $\rightarrow$ 5)

Total CP spent on Skills: **8 CP** (4 points $\times$ 2 CP).

## 6. Purchase Resources with CP

* All characters start with `{python} assign('Nuyen', 10000)` (10,000¥ free).
* We purchase **10 CP of resources** at 20,000¥ per CP (*6WC*, p. 29):
  * `{python} inc_many(('Nuyen', 200000), ('Character_Points', -10))`

* **2 Complex Forms Purchased with CP** (2 CP each, *6WC*, p. 29):
  * **Hyperthreading** (*Hack & Slash*, p. 131): `{python} inc('Character_Points', -2)` `{python} complex_form('Hyperthreading', fading=3, duration='Immediate', target='Persona', notes='Allows simultaneous threading of multiple complex forms in a single action.')`
  * **Machine Merge** (*Hack & Slash*, pp. 64–65): `{python} inc('Character_Points', -2)` `{python} complex_form('Machine Merge', fading=4, duration='Sustained', target='Piloted Device', notes='Grants +1 bonus die per 2 hits to Piloting, Engineering, and defense tests while jumped in.')`

Total CP spent on Resources & Complex Forms: **14 CP** (`10 CP` = +200,000¥ $\rightarrow$ **210,000¥ total budget**; `4 CP` = 2 Complex Forms).

::: {.callout-tip title="Resource CP Optimization (+4 CP Recovered)"}
In the raw XML (`Ouro.xml`), CommLink 6 logged `"cpToResources": 14` (290,000¥). However, after taking all 4 codemods as Omega-Grade, accounting for the Nurse MAID drone's stock benefits, and verifying exact program prices (Basic Programs @ 60¥, MeFeed @ 0¥, Nexus Protocol @ 1,000¥), Ouro's core baseline equipment totals **207,840¥**. 

By reducing resource investment from 14 CP to **10 CP (210,000¥)**, Ouro fully funds every single item from the XML with **2,160¥** in pocket cash, **freeing up 4 Character Points (CP)** to spend on Attributes, Special Attributes, Skills, or Complex Forms!
:::

## 9. Codemods, Spark, and Resonance Impact

In *Hack & Slash* (p. 125–128), digital intelligences augment their core code through **Codemods**. Instead of biological Essence, AIs possess **Spark** (base 6.0). Codemods induce **Spark Loss**, functioning identically to cyberware Essence reduction for Awakened/Emerged characters.

By taking all codemods as **Omega-Grade (Used)** code (*Hack & Slash*, p. 125), Ouro reduces the nuyen cost of every codemod by **50%** at the trade-off of a $+10\%$ increase in Spark loss ($\times 1.1$).

### Codemods Suite (All Omega-Grade / Used)

1. **Synthetic Skill Driver: Activesoft (Rating 6) [Omega-Grade]** (*Hack & Slash*, p. 125, 127)
   * **Cost**: Base 150,000¥ $\times 0.5$ = **75,000¥** `{python} inc('Nuyen', -75000)` (saves 75,000¥)
   * **Spark Loss**: Base $6 \times 0.1 = 0.60 \times 1.1 = \mathbf{0.66\text{ Spark}}$
   * **Effect**: Dedicated virtual skilljack hook supporting any single Activesoft up to Rating 6.
2. **Damage Mitigation Protocols [Omega-Grade]** (*Hack & Slash*, pp. 125–126)
   * **Cost**: Base 18,500¥ $\times 0.5$ = **9,250¥** `{python} inc('Nuyen', -9250)` (saves 9,250¥)
   * **Spark Loss**: Base $0.20 \times 1.1 = \mathbf{0.22\text{ Spark}}$
   * **Effect**: Any time Ouro takes 2 or more boxes of damage to his Condition Monitor (Matrix spikes, biofeedback, dumpshock, or Complex Form Fading), reduces the incoming damage by 1 box.
3. **Optimized Restoration [Omega-Grade]** (*Hack & Slash*, pp. 125–127)
   * **Cost**: Base 10,000¥ $\times 0.5$ = **5,000¥** `{python} inc('Nuyen', -5000)` (saves 5,000¥)
   * **Spark Loss**: Base $0.10 \times 1.1 = \mathbf{0.11\text{ Spark}}$
   * **Effect**: Doubles uptime before restoration and drops restoration cycle time from 3 hours to 1 hour (trimming a full `1h` rest + `8h` Rating 8 sprite registration night down to 9 hours).

### Spark and Resonance Calculation

* Initial Spark: **6.00**
* Total Spark Loss: $0.66 + 0.22 + 0.11 = \mathbf{0.99\text{ Spark}}$ `{python} inc('Spark', -0.99)`
* Remaining Spark: **`{python} round(Spark, 2)`**
* **Resonance Reduction**:
  * Per *SR6 CRB* p. 66 and *Hack & Slash* p. 125, crossing an integer Essence/Spark boundary drops Resonance by 1 point.
  * Because remaining Spark is **5.01** (safely above the 5.0 boundary by 0.01 Spark!), it crosses only the 6.0 integer boundary $\rightarrow$ **Resonance drops from 6 to 5** `{python} inc('Resonance', -1)`.
  * *Economic Arbitrage*: Taking all 3 codemods as Omega-Grade saves a cumulative **89,250¥** (cutting total codemods cost from 178,500¥ to **89,250¥** with zero Illegal `(I)` tags) while keeping final Spark strictly above 5.0, incurring zero additional Resonance loss!

  * **Honorbound (Pirate's Code)** (*CRB*, p. 76–77): `{python} inc('Karma', 10)`
    * Bound by an inviolable ethical code. Unlocks the *Candle in the Dark* quality pathway in post-chargen advancement.
* **Upgraded Metatype & Conferred Qualities**:
  * **Pilot Origins (Rating 3)** (*Hack & Slash*, p. 114–115, 120): `{python} inc('Karma', -16)`
    * Inherent Pilot AI metatype trait (Rating 1 free). Upgraded by 2 ranks to Rating 3 (8 Karma/level), granting the full benefits of a **Rating 3 Control Rig** when jumped into drones/vehicles and allowing loading/converting autosofts up to Data Processing. Because it is upgraded beyond the metatype baseline, it counts as 1 of Ouro's 6 chargen qualities.
  * *Sensor Upgrade*: Inherent Metatype Trait (*Hack & Slash*, p. 114).

::: {.callout-note title="Qualities Accounting (6-Slot Compliant)"}
* **Total Qualities Counted at Chargen**: Exactly **6** (3 Positive: `Sourceror Stream`, `Natural Hacker`, `Pilot Origins R3` upgrade; 3 Negative: `Glitchy`, `Hooder R3`, `Honorbound`), strictly complying with the 6-quality chargen ceiling (*CRB*, p. 66).
* **Positive Karma**: -51 Karma (-20 Sourceror, -15 Natural Hacker, -16 Pilot Origins R1 $\rightarrow$ R3).
* **Negative Karma**: +37 Karma (+12 Glitchy, +15 Hooder R3, +10 Honorbound).
* **Net Quality Balance**: **-14 Karma** (strictly within the $\le +20$ net bonus Karma ceiling).

## 11. Submersion, MUG Affiliation, Foci, and Complex Forms

### Matrix User Group (MUG) Affiliation: River People

Per *Street Wyrd* p. 128 and *SRMG v2.4* p. 59–60, joining an established Matrix User Group (MUG) or magical coven requires spending **6 Karma**:
* `{python} inc('Karma', -6)`

Joining the **River People** at **Connection 7 / Loyalty 8** grants maximum group submersion discounts: the Karma cost of each Submersion is discounted by the group's Loyalty rating (**-8 Karma per grade**, minimum 2 Karma per *Hack & Slash* p. 101).

### Submersion & Echoes (Grades 1 & 2 with Loyalty 8 MUG Discount)

Under *Hack & Slash* p. 101 (*Symmetrical Submersion*), group submersion cost is reduced by the group's Loyalty rating to a minimum of 2 Karma:

* **Submersion Grade 1**:
  * Base Cost (*CRB*, p. 195): $10 + 1 = 11\text{ Karma}$
  * River People Group Discount (Loyalty 8): $-8\text{ Karma}$
  * Final Cost: $11 - 8 = \mathbf{3\text{ Karma}}$ `{python} inc('Karma', -3)` `{python} echo('Sprite Conduit')`
  * **Echo: Sprite Conduit**: Enables direct resonance channeling through compiled and registered sprites.
* **Submersion Grade 2**:
  * Base Cost: $10 + 2 = 12\text{ Karma}$
  * River People Group Discount (Loyalty 8): $-8\text{ Karma}$
  * Final Cost: $12 - 8 = \mathbf{4\text{ Karma}}$ `{python} inc('Karma', -4)` `{python} echo('Sprite Symbiosis')`
  * **Echo: Sprite Symbiosis**: Weaves the living persona's defensive architecture directly into active companion sprites.

::: {.callout-tip title="MUG Karma Arbitrage (+10 Karma Net Saved on Submersions)"}
* Total Submersion base cost: $11 + 12 = 23\text{ Karma}$.
* Discounted Submersion cost with River People (Loyalty 8): $3 + 4 = 7\text{ Karma}$ (**16 Karma saved** vs base, and **8 Karma saved** vs Loyalty 4!).
* Net savings after 6 Karma group join fee: $16 - 6 = \mathbf{+10\text{ Karma net savings}}$!
:::

### Focus Bonding

* **Resonance Focus (Rating 4)**:
  * Bonding Cost: $\text{Rating} \times 1 = \mathbf{4\text{ Karma}}$ `{python} inc('Karma', -4)`

## Post-Chargen Progression: Three-Tracker Upgrade Protocol

Because post-chargen advancement is gated by **three independent finite resources**—**Major Downtime Actions** (Mainline SRMs only), **Karma** (SRMs + CMPs + *Work for the People*), and **Nuyen** (DIY 50% hardware & software)—progression is tracked in three parallel queues. Whenever an upgrade opportunity opens, execute in strict priority order: **1) Submersion (Tracker 1)** $\rightarrow$ **2) Karma Queue (Tracker 2)** $\rightarrow$ **3) Nuyen / DIY Hardware Queue (Tracker 3)**.

---

### 1. Downtime Action Economy & Allocation Protocol

Under *SRM Guide v2.4* (pp. 17–20, 59–60), downtime actions between missions are strictly budgeted:

* **Mainline SRM Missions:** Grant **1 Major + 1 Minor** Action (or **3 Minor Actions** if taking no Major).
* **Convention Mission Packs (CMPs):** Grant **2 Minor Actions only** (no Major Action; Submersion cannot be performed post-CMP).
* **The CMP Karma Banking Strategy:**
  * CMPs award nuyen and Karma but grant only Minor downtime actions and do not trigger monthly rent or calendar degradation (*SRMG v2.4*, p. 17).
  * We bank CMP Karma directly toward **raising natural Resonance** (Resonance 5 $\rightarrow$ 6 for 30 Karma, 6 $\rightarrow$ 7 for 35 Karma, 7 $\rightarrow$ 8 for 40 Karma), which requires zero downtime actions and can be purchased between runs.
  * Prioritizing natural Resonance ensures Ouro continually raises the Submersion Grade ceiling ($\text{Grade} \le \text{Resonance}$) and expands sprite registering capacity to maximize the high MUG Loyalty discounts before decay reaches the Loyalty 4 floor!
* **The MUG Decay Protocol (River People):**
  * Starts at **Loyalty 8** (decaying $8 \rightarrow 7 \rightarrow 6 \rightarrow 5 \rightarrow 4$ over upcoming months without maintenance).
  * *Submersion Cost Formula:* In SRM with an active MUG possessing *Symmetrical Submersion* (*Hack & Slash*, p. 101), submersion Karma cost is:
    $$\text{Cost} = 10 + \text{Target Submersion Grade} - \text{MUG Loyalty}$$
    *(Minimum 2 Karma per Hack & Slash p. 101).*
    *Because rent and calendar advancement are settled every second SRM, Ouro can submerge twice at each Loyalty rating before decay occurs!*
  * *Action & Nuyen Dividends:* Rather than wasting 1 Major Downtime Action every other SRM to maintain Loyalty 8, we intentionally allow Loyalty to decay by 1 rating per month. Freeing these Major Actions liberates **4 Major Downtime Actions** across Months 1–4 and saves **¥4,800** in unspent dues across Months 1 & 2!
  * *The Loyalty 4 Floor:* At Loyalty 4, maintenance costs only **1 Minor Downtime Action per month** and dues drop to **¥350/mo** ($50 \times \text{Connection 7}$). This permanently preserves a **-4 Karma submersion discount** while leaving every single SRM Major Downtime Action unencumbered.
* **The Hooder R3 Synergy:**
  * Hooder (Rating 3) mandates **¥3,000/month** in charitable donations (*6WC*, p. 137).
  * Under *SRMG v2.4* p. 19, this monthly donation directly funds the **Work for the People** Minor Downtime Action (+1 Karma per month) at zero additional nuyen charge!
  * **Monthly Downtime Allocation (Every 2 SRMs = 1 Month):**
    * **2 Major Downtime Actions:** 100% dedicated to Submersions (2 per month, 1 per SRM).
    * **2 Minor Downtime Actions:**
      1. SRM 1: *Work for the People* (+1 Karma).
      2. SRM 2: *River People MUG Maintenance at Loyalty 4 Floor* (1 Minor Action, ¥350/mo dues).

---
